verdict.line: On INTEL(R) XEON(R) PLATINUM 8573C: Google's 0.30% holds for forward loops with loops aligned (at most 1.7% on k01_sum_fwd, k03_stencil); a loop that loses vectorization under the same check (k04_rev, k05_stride2, k08_matmul) pays 3.93 times (range 3.15 to 6.61; as compiled 4.17), because it loses SIMD. Placement-sensitive, listed and not counted: k02_add_fwd.L1 (as compiled 1.07, aligned 1.06); k02_add_fwd.L2 (as compiled 1.02, aligned 0.97); k03_stencil.L2 (as compiled 1.02, aligned 1.00).
verdict.why: MAP: every counted in-cache cell of k01_sum_fwd, k03_stencil has aligned ratio <= 1.02 and aligned ci95_hi <= 1.0330; every in-cache cell of k04_rev, k05_stride2, k08_matmul has ci95_lo >= 1.5 in both columns; placement-sensitive (layout A/A half-width 1.44%): k02_add_fwd.L1, k02_add_fwd.L2, k03_stencil.L2

verdict_v1.line: INCONCLUSIVE: a mixed picture that fits neither the map nor holds-everywhere (forward rule missed by k02_add_fwd.L1, k03_stencil.L2; cells above the forward limit: k02_add_fwd.L1, k04_rev.L1, k04_rev.L2, k05_stride2.L1, k05_stride2.L2, k08_matmul.L1, k08_matmul.L2); no headline number is printed.
